explanation: This method is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because .format(project_id, str(expiry_date)) interpolates arguments directly into the raw SQL string executed via db.engine.execute(). If non-integer input reaches project_id, an attacker could alter the SELECT query to expose or unlock unauthorized tasks. The repair wraps the query in SQLAlchemy text() with named bind parameters (:project_id, :expiry_date), safely separating query structure from data.
